translations.web: “Now this is that which you shall offer on the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
translations.bsb: This is what you are to offer regularly on the altar, each day: two lambs that are a year old.
translations.kjv: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar; two lambs of the first year day by day continually.
translations.asv: Now this is that which thou shalt offer upon the altar: two lambs a year old day by day continually.
